text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the parking regulations on the west side of Logan Avenue, in the vicinity of Frankland Community School to better facilitate student pick-up and drop-off activities. The proposed change will not impact traffic operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes between 8:30 a.m. and 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Logan Avenue from a point 50 metres south of Danforth Avenue to a point 38.2 metres further south to be in effect between 7:30 a.m. and 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday. 2. Approved the reduction of overnight permit parking hours on the west side of Logan Avenue, between Garnock Avenue and Danforth Avenue, from the current 12:01 a.m. to 8:30 a.m., seven days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:30 a.m., seven days a week. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition on the west side of Logan Avenue, between a point 69 metres south of Danforth Avenue and a point 27.8 metres further south, in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday.
